name: Enterprise Analytical Study, Finding and Recommendation Binding
constraints: WM-ACT-036 owns analytical study identity, question, protocol, population, sampling, method application, estimates and limitations.
WM-KNW-007 owns finding and recommendation claims with evidence, scope, assumptions, defeaters and confidence.

WM-KNW-010 owns decision rationale and alternatives while WM-ACT-024 owns the authorized occurrence.
Recommendations have no deciding authority or effect until accepted through both decision content and authorized occurrence.
Reports render pinned findings but never own analytical conclusions or justification.
holds: Recommendation specialization and relation contracts require reconciliation.
